sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 31 points, travel to Telford Town on Saturday looking to bounce back from consecutive league defeats. The Ramblers face a struggling Telford side sitting second-bottom, before returning to action the following Saturday in the Edward Case Cup when they host New Mills at home.
divisionWide: Saturday's opening round sees several significant clashes: second-placed Stafford Town (29 pts, W-D-D-W-D-D form) travel to AFC Bridgnorth (27 pts, W-D-W-D-L-W), with only two points separating them; third-placed Eccleshall host New Mills in a fixture between in-form sides; and in-form Wolverhampton Casuals (28 pts, five consecutive wins) welcome struggling Foley Meir. Other Saturday fixtures include Allscott Heath versus Wednesfield Community, Alsager Town at Widnes Town, Barnton hosting Market Drayton Town, Brereton Social against Shawbury United, and Cheadle Heath Nomads at Bilston Town. Midweek action on Tuesday sees Widnes Town travel to AFC Bridgnorth. Wednesday's midweek clashes feature Bilston Town hosting Alsager Town and Wolverhampton Casuals at New Mills in the Edward Case Cup. By Saturday 14 November, the fixture list resets with Allscott Heath hosting Dawley Town, Bilston Town welcoming Eccleshall, Brereton Social at home to Crewe, Foley Meir visiting Market Drayton Town, Telford Town hosting Cheadle Heath Nomads, and Wednesfield Community away at Widnes Town.
